versions.changelog:
- Added sample references and scripts directories.
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- No user-facing functionality changes.

Initial release of Sleep Debt Calculator.

- Track and log nightly sleep with quality and notes via CLI.
- Calculate accumulated sleep debt against age-based optimal sleep.
- Generate evidence-based recovery schedules.
- Detect chronotype (early bird vs night owl) from sleep patterns.
- Chart sleep duration with ASCII plots.
- Flag and analyze the impact of caffeine/alcohol through note tracking.
- All data stored locally in a JSON file; pure Python, no dependencies.
